description: |x| from 3 to 10: the gradient vanishes below and tends to g above.
reference: torch.autograd.grad(F.gelu(x, approximate="tanh"), (x,), grad_out) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: PyTorch's f32 gradient loses relative accuracy below x = -4 (1 + tanh cancels), so these values use the default tolerances. Expected values are PyTorch's (autograd) in f64 on the f32 tensors, rounded once to f32; PyTorch's own f32 result meets tolerance and gradient_tolerance (checked by the generator).
